requirements.text: Master’s degree from an accredited university or college in a technical field such as engineering, computer science, math, or physics.

Minimum of 4 years of relevant experience applying theoretical or experiential knowledge to solve real-world problems in MR image acquisition, reconstruction, image processing, or related application development.
Strong knowledge of MR physics, including pulse sequences, acquisition techniques, k-space sampling, reconstruction strategies, image artifacts, and clinical imaging requirements.

Proficiency with modern programming languages such as Python or C++, machine learning frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow, containerized software environments, version control systems, and AI-enabled software development tools.
Strong foundation in signal processing, inverse problems, and numerical optimization.
Ability to work independently with minimal direction.
Strong collaboration skills and desire to contribute to a common purpose.
Can-do attitude; self-driven, flexible, intellectually curious, and willing to learn new skills and take on new challenges to meet business goals.

We will not sponsor individuals for employment visas, now or in the future, for this job opening. For U.S. based positions only, the pay range for this position is $130,000.00-$195,000.00 Annual. It is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the pay range and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. The specific compensation offered to a candidate may be influenced by a variety of factors including skills, qualifications, experience and location. In addition, this position may also be eligible to earn performance based incentive compensation, which may include cash bonus(es) and/or long term incentives (LTI). GE HealthCare offers a competitive benefits package, including not but limited to medical, dental, vision, paid time off, a 401(k) plan with employee and company contribution opportunities, life, disability, and accident insurance, and tuition reimbursement.
